original_formula.model: Score v2 historic calculation, NOT a forward-looking performance guarantee
original_formula.weekly_resample: W-FRI: last available daily observation within week; completed Friday only
model_limitations: Original current-vintage full-sample z-scores can change with new history, and are not historical as-published vintages.
Do not change series/futures rolls or normalization windows silently.
Formula is not a provider-data redistribution grant.

source_preference.description: Highest semantic fidelity in principle: exactly the original 8 input definitions through authorized publisher or distributor, preserving dates, rolls, vintages, history and calculation. Actual fidelity and all rights still unverified.
Direct Treasury/Federal Reserve 2Y/10Y may approximate the two original constant-maturity rate inputs, after live same-date and vintage parity testing; does not solve the other six.
Trade-weighted Fed USD, WTI spot, financial stress or other official measures change driver meaning; research as a separately named educational model only, not a replacement Score v2.

requirements: Compare only data each party can lawfully retrieve/retain/process and only after original and candidate source approvals.
Lock original model weights and sample settings BEFORE comparison; align identical Friday periods, timezone/holidays, event availability and source vintages.
Preserve reference score metadata privately with approved rights; no component values or derived normalized histories in public URLs.
Use a development-only held-out period and record rows/time window and completeness; do not optimize on evaluation data.
metrics: revision_stability = source vintages and recomputation drift evaluated independently
comparison_protocol.result: UNKNOWN; never label a provider or alternative as the empirically closest Score before rights-cleared comparisons.

reader_guidance.en: For the closest defensible reconstruction, use the exact original inputs from verified, appropriately licensed sources and reproduce the published transformation precisely. If any input must be substituted, label the result a different educational model, disclose the substitutions and quantify similarity only after a lawful comparative test. An example with invented data proves the arithmetic, not market accuracy.
reader_guidance.es: Para reconstruir el resultado de la forma más fiel posible, use las series originales exactas de fuentes verificadas y con licencia o permiso adecuado, y reproduzca el cálculo publicado. Si sustituye alguna serie, presente el resultado como otro modelo educativo, explique los cambios y cuantifique la similitud solo tras una prueba comparativa autorizada. Los datos inventados muestran la aritmética, no la precisión del mercado.
